summary: Feed c036_nic_broker is degraded: BROKER-A port 5 to NDR discarding 56.72% (98,287,500 pkts, avg 100% of 10 Gbps, bursts higher) plus NDR eth1 discarding 4.82% (3,613,320 pkts) - NDR missing majority of traffic due to egress congestion and capture overload

findings.root_cause: BROKER-A egress port 5 is persistently saturated at 100% of 10 Gbps average (bursts exceed line rate) causing 56.72% output discards, and the NDR 10G capture interface eth1 cannot keep up discarding an additional 4.82%. Classic oversubscription: aggregate feed exceeds single 10G tool port capacity.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR misses >50% of packets/flows before analysis. Breaks both-direction correlation (NDR needs both directions) and full-payload inspection, causing missed detections, incomplete sessions, inaccurate analytics and blind spots.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute >10G aggregate across 2+ 10G NDR interfaces with 5-tuple hashing preserving flow symmetry to eliminate broker egress drops and keep per-NIC load below capture capacity. Alternative is tool_capacity upgrade to 25/40/100G NICs or adding NDR cluster nodes if single-port capture is required; do not slice as NDR needs full payload.
